title: DHIS2 Android plugin identity
description: Who this plugin is. The build reads it in settings.gradle.kts; tools/identity.py reads it for the Python gates. Nothing else may repeat these values — tools/check-identity.py fails when the source tree and this file disagree.

name.description: Display name, shown in the harness and used as the card's default title.

slug.description: Gradle rootProject.name. Kebab-case: a space here reaches Compose Resources as a backtick-escaped package.

pluginId.description: Reverse-domain id the server dataStore config names. Hyphens allowed, unlike the Kotlin package.

package.description: Kotlin package root. Also the Android namespace, and the stem of resourcePackage and harnessApplicationId.

entryPoint.description: Simple class name of the Dhis2Plugin implementation. Its FQCN is package + '.' + entryPoint.

version.description: The plugin's version. The Capture App caches bundles by {id}-{version}.zip, so a change shipped at an unchanged version keeps running the old code on device.

injectionPoints.description: Host slots this plugin renders in, written into the generated plugin-config.json. Only slots plugin-sdk defines are honoured — an app that has never heard of one drops it when it reads the config, leaving the plugin rendering nowhere. check-identity.py enforces the list.

slotConfig.description: Per-slot configuration, keyed by injection point, written into the generated plugin-config.json. Replacement slots render nowhere until it says which objects they apply to. A rendering filter, never an access grant — it narrows nothing about what the plugin can read or write.

DATA_SET_INSTANCE_CONTENT.description: Which data set instances this plugin draws the body of. An empty list replaces nothing, so it doubles as a kill switch that does not require deleting the plugin's entry.

conventions.description: Where this plugin's own architecture rules apply. {packagePath} and {entryPoint} are expanded. tools/check-rules.py reads these instead of hardcoding filenames.

sdkAllowed.description: The only files permitted to mention org.hisp.dhis.android — the repository implementations. Keeping D2 out of UI and domain code is what keeps them unit-testable and previewable. Adding a path here is a decision worth a commit message.

repositoryInterfaces.description: Interfaces whose every function must return Result — an exception reaching the host composition takes the enclosing screen with it.

initialised.description: False while ./init.sh is mid-run, so a crash leaves an unambiguously partial repo rather than a silently broken one.
